items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Yeah, I worked with him at the Regal Theater when it first opened up.

ctx.x: And who, which other bands were you working with while you were working with Dave Payton?

Well, to tell the truth, I was still with the Lusianans. Mm-hmm. But Dave Payton was just getting up a, what do you call it, something like an all-star band to make a big opening there, see. Mm-hmm. And he made that big opening for two days, Saturday and Sunday I think it was. All day Sunday and Saturday night. And then after that he had got his regular band, you know, what he wanted there, but I was still with Francois Lusianan. Mm-hmm. Yeah. I see. So, how many years were you with Francois? Well I'm going to be…
What year was it you took sick? Do you remember?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: I didn't know him that good. ... them guys like Dave Payton, Fletcher Henderson, them guys used to write stuff for them boys

ctx.x: Turn around to the side a little bit. Now that's about a thirty degree angle up, huh? Mm-hmm. Maybe forty-five, something like that. You never did know his real name like this, yeah?

No. He called himself Kid Punch II. That's what he called himself. I didn't know him that good. He's from over in Algea, I think. And he'd come over here to play a parade or something. And I was like working out at Spanish Food that Sunday, on a Sunday. Boy, that was a worrisome thing to me. Somebody come out there and say, Punch Eight Fell Dave. That was a mess. I kept fooling around there like that, you know. I wonder what's wrong.
Who were you working with at Spanish for? I had my little band there. Kid Punch. How many bands did they have out there in Spanish?
